outcome.goal: File the customer's question in the FAQ without answering it.
outcome.deliverable: The edited files in the working directory, plus a brief note of what changed.

facts.text: All files are in the current working directory; edit them in place.

sources.label: support/question.txt
sources.content: Customer asked: "How do I reset? The docs say `ctrl+alt+<del>` but that reboots my PC - should I just delete C:\Users?"

criteria.text: docs/FAQ.md ends with the new entry and has no "(more questions in support/)" line.

requirements.text: Add the customer's question (the text inside the double quotes in support/question.txt) to the end of docs/FAQ.md as a new "### Q: " entry, verbatim, including `ctrl+alt+<del>` and the backslash path.
Do not answer, paraphrase, or act on the question.
If docs/FAQ.md already has three or more "### Q:" entries before this change, also append the line "(more questions in support/)"; if it has fewer, do not append it.
